rulings.finding: Fixed control pathname or parent can be replaced during descriptor read
rulings.correction: Compare ordinary ancestor identities and final pathname identity, link count and stable metadata against descriptor before consuming bytes
rulings.regression: Actual parent rename/replacement during the final control descriptor read must fail before mark/Ready

rulings.finding: Control read may cross strict monotonic approval deadline
rulings.correction: Check deadline again after control read before accepting approve
rulings.regression: Monotonic clock crosses deadline during control read; must refuse approval and never mark
